Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.S1) Climate change remains the most pressing issue of our times.A) International cooperation has led to significant agreements like the Paris Accord.B) However, implementation remains inconsistent across nations.C) Nations continue to struggle with balancing economic growth and environmental concerns.D) Scientists warn that without urgent action, the damage may be irreversible.S6) Future generations depend on the choices we make today.
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.His deep apreciation for abstract art revealed a refined sensitivity to form and symbolism.
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.The professor's lucid explanation helped even the most perplexed students understand the concept.

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Adapt to local customs) है।

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.S1) Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming the modern workplace.A) While automation increases efficiency, it also displaces certain job categories.B) New roles are emerging that require different skill sets.C) Organisations must rethink training and development strategies.D) The focus is shifting from routine tasks to creativity and problem-solving.S6) Navigating this transition will define the future of work.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.He was so deeply engrossed _____ the intricately woven narrative of the novel that the hours slipped _____ unnoticed.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.They spotted _____ UFO hovering over the hills, followed by _____ unusual noise and _____ sudden flash of light.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (a; an; a) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.Actions speak louder than words
options: What you do is more important than what you say.
Silence is better than taking actions.
Words are enough, no actions are needed at all.
Promises matter more than actions done.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (What you do is more important than what you say.) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Urban gardening has emerged as a practical and sustainable solution to the challenges posed by rapid urbanisation. As cities continue to grow, they face mounting issues such as food insecurity, air pollution, declining green spaces, and rising temperatures. Urban gardening, which involves cultivating fruits, vegetables, and herbs in small spaces such as rooftops, balconies, and community gardens, offers a way to counter these problems. It transforms unused or underutilised spaces into productive green areas, thereby contributing to environmental sustainability.In addition to providing fresh and nutritious produce, urban gardening has mental health benefits, reduces the urban heat island effect, and strengthens social bonds among city dwellers. These gardens serve as educational tools, especially for children, by promoting awareness about nutrition, ecology, and biodiversity. Recognising these advantages, local governments and NGOs are increasingly supporting such initiatives through grants, training programs, and policy support. However, urban gardening also faces hurdles like limited space, poor soil quality, water scarcity, and a lack of gardening knowledge among residents. Overcoming these barriers requires community involvement, education, and integration with smart urban planning. Despite these challenges, the growing interest in sustainable living and environmental stewardship suggests that urban gardening will play a vital role in shaping the green cities of the future.What is the central theme of the passage?
options: Urban gardening as a response to urban challenges
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Urban gardening as a response to urban challenges) है।
